name: Mantra
description: The Skypiean road into Observation Haki, starting at sense presence.

stages.name: Listen
stages.description: The Skypiean road into Observation: listen to everything.
stages.text: You heard the voices of the island in the quiet.

stages.name: Hear the voices
stages.description: Hear what people are about to do.
stages.text: You heard what they were about to do, and stepped aside.

stages.name: Mantra mastered
stages.text: You heard a whole island at once.
